name: Silly Monks Entertainment Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, Silly Monks Entertainment Ltd works in the fields of digital content publishing, content production, content distribution, syndication, marketing, and as a strategic consulting company.Silly Monks is the 1st Entertainment Company in south India covering all four states and has the largest YouTube Multi-Channel Network with a strong footprint in the food community, wellness community, movie production, short films, etc.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
The company is in the business of providing the following services:
a) Digital Media publishing of content
b) Movie/ Series/Content Production
c) Audio – Video Content Syndication and Distribution
d) Celebrity
e) Marketing and Promotion

cons: Stock is trading at 3.27 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -4.12% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -18.0% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
